To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

authentic leaders are those who have a clear sense of their values and beliefs, who are able to process and act upon information in a manner that is consistent with these values and beliefs, and who have a genuine concern for the well-being of their followers.
Authenticity, as a personal characteristic and as a leadership style, is a key determinant of leader and follower well-being.
Authenticity is the core construct of authentic leadership, which is a multi-component construct that is rooted in the eudaemonic tradition of human well-being.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the concept of authentic leader and its influence on leader and follower well-being.
understanding the concept of authentic leaders and their influence on the eudaemonic well being of followers.
the development of authentic leaders.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

authentic leadership is the process by which leaders develop their self-awareness, self-regulated, unbiased processing, authenticity, relational orientation and other positive psychological states, which in turn, influence their followers’ eudaemonic well being.
authentic leadership, in its various components, has been shown to have a positive influence on the well-being of leaders, followers and organizations.
the more authentic the leader, the more eudaimonically fulfilled both the leader and the followers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the authentic leader is one who is self-aware, unbiased, authentic in his or her behavior and authentic in his or he relationships.

we have developed an integrated model of authentic leadership, which is based on the concept of authentic behavior and authentic relational orientation, and we have examined the influences of authentic leadership on leader eudaemonic well- being and on follower eudaemonic and hedonic well-being, as mediated through leader eudaemonic and follower euda- monic well-being.
we have provided a conceptualization of authentic leadership and its antecedents, processes and consequences.
The main takeaway from our work is that

authentic leaders have the ability to influence the well-being of their followers, and that this influence is mediated by the leader’s ability to be self-aware, process information in a non-biased manner, and to act authentically.
authentic leadership is an important construct that can be used to understand and improve leader and follower eudemonic well-being.

authentic leadership is an important concept that has the potential to enhance both leader and follower well-being and that the concept of authentic leader well-being should be given more prominence in authentic leadership research.
